description: Take one of the developer's Caps live. Nothing is reviewed before launch and nobody approves it: when the applicable connection/operation checks and price book pass, with complete billed-operation docs, this lists a new Cap immediately. Existing Cap updates retain their effective version and notice period; submit_cap does not advance a pending contract. Run test_cap first (legacy checklist keys remain signature and end_to_end; the price book is recorded when it saves). Passing native connection checks or isolated fixtures does not verify real delivery. Qumge spot-checks docs and support afterwards and can suspend the Cap. Needs the developer's Qumge key. (Older clients may still call this tool as submit_app_review.)

qumge_key.description: Optional: your Qumge API key, for clients that cannot set an Authorization header. Takes precedence over the header. Never echoed back.

name: submit_cap
